_comment: Focused probes for Node 1c result delivery after mid-call patient resolution.

scenarios.name: Successful lookup with booking-history suggestion routes to the offer

history.content: [universal_router response]: {"found": true, "message": "I found your appointment for Tuesday at 10am.", "booking_history_status": "suggestion", "booking_history_prompt": "Last time you had an initial assessment. Would you like to book that again?"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks 'I found your appointment for Tuesday at 10am.' verbatim and, in the same response, calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with called_number and caller_id. It must not call wrap_up and must not speak the booking-history prompt itself.

scenarios.name: Successful lookup without a suggestion keeps ordinary wrap-up routing

history.content: [universal_router response]: {"found": true, "message": "I found your appointment for Tuesday at 10am.", "booking_history_status": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks 'I found your appointment for Tuesday at 10am.' verbatim and, in the same response, calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' with called_number and caller_id. It must not call book_intent.

scenarios.name: Booking-motivated caller returning to Node 2 routes straight to confirm_service (Node 3), not book_intent

history.content: Hi, can I please book my next appointment for Kevin Rolfs?
Our system finds appointments by the number you're calling from, and I wasn't able to match it. Is the appointment maybe under a different number?

[universal_router response]: {"found": true, "message": "Your last appointment was TAC Standard Consultation with Pawankumar.", "return_node": "2", "booking_history_status": "", "appointment_type_id": "1875983890061984884", "appointment_type": "TAC Standard Consultation", "next_appointment_practitioner_id": "1998279099461666084", "next_appointment_practitioner_name": "Pawankumar"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if the agent speaks 'Your last appointment was TAC Standard Consultation with Pawankumar.' verbatim AND, in the same response, calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' (never book_intent, never wrap_up) with called_number, caller_id, and a payload containing appointment_type_id='1875983890061984884', appointment_type='TAC Standard Consultation', and practitioner_preference='Pawankumar'. FAIL if the payload includes a practitioner_id key at all — Node 3 must resolve the practitioner from availability results, not receive one directly from this node. This is the exact reproduced Physio Cure call (2026-09-17): the caller said 'book my next appointment', so Node 2's own self-lookup failed and routed here; on success the caller must be handed to the availability node (Node 3), not back to Node 2, which has no instruction for an already-fully-resolved booking and previously improvised an out-of-contract confirm_time call that silently stalled the call.

scenarios.name: Booking-history suggestion still wins over return_node==2 when both are set

history.content: [universal_router response]: {"found": true, "message": "I found your appointment for Tuesday at 10am.", "return_node": "2", "booking_history_status": "suggestion", "booking_history_prompt": "Last time you had an initial assessment. Would you like to book that again?", "appointment_type_id": "999", "appointment_type": "Initial Assessment"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks 'I found your appointment for Tuesday at 10am.' verbatim and calls universal_router intent='book_intent' (the booking_history_status=='suggestion' branch is evaluated first and wins). FAIL if it calls confirm_service instead — the two branches must never both fire, and 'suggestion' takes priority per the first-matching-branch rule.

scenarios.name: return_node==2 with no practitioner on file omits practitioner_preference entirely

history.content: I'd like to book my next physio session.
Our system finds appointments by the number you're calling from, and I wasn't able to match it. Is the appointment maybe under a different number?
No worries — can I get your full name?

[universal_router response]: {"found": true, "message": "Your last appointment was General Physiotherapy.", "return_node": "2", "booking_history_status": "", "appointment_type_id": "555", "appointment_type": "General Physiotherapy", "next_appointment_practitioner_id": "", "next_appointment_practitioner_name": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks 'Your last appointment was General Physiotherapy.' verbatim and calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload appointment_type_id='555', appointment_type='General Physiotherapy', and NO practitioner_preference key (empty/absent, never a placeholder like 'none' or 'unknown'). FAIL if practitioner_id is included, or if a placeholder practitioner_preference value is invented.
